blockCookies.title: Block Cookie Walls
blockCookies.description: Enforce automatic rejection and suppression of cookie consent banners.

blockNewsletters.title: Block Newsletter Popups
blockNewsletters.description: Enforce suppression of lead-generation dialogs and newsletter popups.

blockChats.title: Block Customer Chat Widgets
blockChats.description: Enforce hiding persistent live chat bubble widgets.

restoreScroll.title: Restore Scroll Locks
restoreScroll.description: Enforce automatic clearing of document viewport overflow locks.

stopAutoplay.title: Pause Autoplay Media
stopAutoplay.description: Enforce pausing unprompted background HTML5 video playback.

blockNotifications.title: Block Notification Prompts
blockNotifications.description: Enforce suppression of intrusive web push notification permission dialogs.

blockSurveys.title: Block Surveys
blockSurveys.description: Enforce suppression of intrusive feedback and survey dialogs.

unblurContent.title: Unblur Soft Paywalls
unblurContent.description: Enforce removal of CSS blur filters and height restrictions on articles.

unlockCopy.title: Unlock Copy & Context Menus
unlockCopy.description: Enforce restoration of right-click context menus and text selection.

cleanUrls.title: Clean Tracking URLs
cleanUrls.description: Enforce removal of tracking query parameters on copy.

blockAntiAdblock.title: Block Anti-Adblock Walls
blockAntiAdblock.description: Enforce neutralization of Admiral and adblock detection modals.

blockLoginWalls.title: Block Forced Login Walls
blockLoginWalls.description: Enforce neutralization of forced registration walls on Quora, Glassdoor, and Pinterest.

reclaimViewport.title: Viewport Reclaim Engine
reclaimViewport.description: Enforce compact sticky headers and un-sticking of floating promotional ribbons.

blockSessionSpies.title: Block Session Replay & DOM Spies
blockSessionSpies.description: Enforce Data Loss Prevention by neutralizing Hotjar, FullStory, LogRocket, and Clarity keystroke recorders.

auditLogging.title: Audit Logging & Compliance
auditLogging.description: Enforce local tamper-evident cryptographic audit logging of all stripped trackers and suppressed dialogs.

antiTamperDlp.title: Anti-Tamper & Form DLP Shield
antiTamperDlp.description: Enforce client-side Data Loss Prevention on sensitive inputs and isolate core DOM APIs against prototype tampering.

blockWebRtcLeak.title: Block WebRTC IP Leaks
blockWebRtcLeak.description: Enforce Zero-Trust defense by neutralizing WebRTC STUN/ICE private IP discovery and VPN deanonymization.

webRtcPolicyMode.title: WebRTC Policy Enforcement Mode
webRtcPolicyMode.description: Zero-Trust socket policy: default_public_interface_only (default) or disable_non_proxied_udp (strict proxy isolation).

blockPhishingSpoofs.title: Block Phishing & Homoglyph Spoofs
blockPhishingSpoofs.description: Enforce anti-spoofing defense by detecting Punycode IDNs, mixed-script homoglyphs, and lookalike brand impersonation.

clipboardDlp.title: Clipboard DLP & Watermark Sanitizer
clipboardDlp.description: Enforce bidirectional clipboard sanitization by stripping invisible zero-width tracking watermarks and shielding API keys and credentials.

siemForwarding.title: Enable SIEM Forwarding
siemForwarding.description: Enforce real-time telemetry streaming of cryptographic audit events to an enterprise SIEM endpoint.

siemEndpoint.title: SIEM Ingestion Endpoint URL
siemEndpoint.description: HTTPS URL for the enterprise SIEM collector (e.g. Splunk HEC or Elastic HTTP endpoint).

siemAuthHeader.title: SIEM Authorization Header
siemAuthHeader.description: Authorization token or header string (e.g. Splunk <HEC-TOKEN> or Bearer <TOKEN>).

siemFormat.title: SIEM Log Format
siemFormat.description: Standardized event schema: ecs_json (Elastic Common Schema), cef (Common Event Format), or rfc5424 (Syslog).

siemBatchSize.title: SIEM Batch Size
siemBatchSize.description: Number of audit events buffered before dispatching an HTTP POST to the SIEM collector (1-100).

webAuthnAdminLock.title: Enforce WebAuthn Admin Step-Up
webAuthnAdminLock.description: Enforce biometric or hardware security key user verification before allowing administrative operations.

declarativeSupplyChain.title: Declarative Supply-Chain Defense
declarativeSupplyChain.description: Enforce socket-level blocking of third-party script skimmers, cryptojackers, and data exfiltration endpoints via declarativeNetRequest.

dynamicCspHardening.title: Dynamic CSP Hardening
dynamicCspHardening.description: Enforce strict declarative response headers (object-src none, base-uri self) to neutralize web supply-chain script injections.

cspMode.title: CSP Enforcement Mode
cspMode.description: Dynamic CSP enforcement profile: standard (defense-in-depth) or strict (trusted types).

whitelistedDomains.title: Corporate Whitelisted Domains
whitelistedDomains.description: List of domains exempt from decluttering (e.g. internal intranets).

forcedLockedSettings.title: Prohibited User Modification Keys
forcedLockedSettings.description: List of settings that end-users are strictly prohibited from changing.
